selectionPolicy: Choose an explicit model and effort pair from this catalog. Catalog support is not account availability. Require a run-specific allowed profile list, record requested and observed model separately, and never silently substitute a fallback.

families.name: Claude Opus 5.5
families.description: Candidate for demanding implementation and integration; historical D025 medium run exists, current account availability still requires run evidence.

families.name: Claude Fable 5.1
families.description: Candidate for difficult long-running investigations; benefit over cheaper profiles must be measured.
families.billingNote: Noninteractive Fable calls can consume usage credits without an interactive consent prompt; catalog inclusion does not authorize an unbounded run.

families.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
families.description: Candidate for scoped implementation; CLI and API defaults differ, so always pass effort explicitly.

families.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
families.description: Candidate for bounded tasks; test quality and instruction adherence before routing larger work to it.

effortDescriptions.low: Latency-sensitive bounded work; validate output instead of assuming equal quality.
effortDescriptions.medium: Initial comparison level for scoped agent tasks.
effortDescriptions.high: Compare on complex or verification-heavy tasks.
effortDescriptions.xhigh: Additional reasoning budget; retain only when measured quality justifies cost.
effortDescriptions.max: Highest exposed level; diminishing returns must be tested. Pass via session CLI flag, not persisted effortLevel.

verificationNotes: Descriptions are routing hypotheses, not benchmark rankings.
ultracode is a workflow setting, not an effort level, and is excluded to avoid adding another orchestrator to the experiment.
CLI organization caps and environment overrides can change applied effort; requested effort is not proof of effective effort.
No paid model availability probe was made while authoring this catalog.
